pr_body:
Updates and improves the BAP broadcast assistant implementation. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41198
depends on https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/51679

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Broadcast assistant
issue_context.body: As a user I want to be able to use the bt_audio API as the broadcast assistant role
comments:
Comments for myself: 

Things to be done: 

New:
- [x] Add support for add local broadcast sources
- [ ] Add broadcast assistant sample
- [ ] Support for parsing BASEs from Broadcast Sources to transfer metadata and subgroup information

Modify:
- [x] Change `uint8_t pa_sync;` to bool and automatically suggest PAST if possible? 
- [ ] Make arguments `const` where possible
- [x] Implement check for PAST possible
- [ ] Update shell
  - [ ] Ensure that it works well with the Broadcast Source shell
  - [ ] Ensure that it works well with the PA Sync shell
- [ ] Get rid of index for bt_bap_broadcast_assistant_read_recv_state
  - [ ] Remove entire function, as we read it during discover and can rely on notifications?
    - [ ] Modify it to a read all? 

Optimize
- [ ] Serialize subscription to reduce recv_state_disc_params

review_comments: `unsigned long` is intentionally used, as that is what the `shell_strtoul` function returns :)
Should broadcast related code be behind a config (to not be included for unicast-only)?
bail out of the loop here?
Maybe there should be ENOTCONN instead of EINVAL what do you think? (applies in multiple places)
ENOTCONN is used if the state of the `conn` pointer is not `CONNECTED`, so to avoid confusion with that we usually use `EINVAL` if the `conn` pointer is just NULL :)
